tab.title: Sam Dharmasiri
tab.purpose: Company-grouped relationship tracker for the 149 CTO-type Sales Navigator contacts returned by the Connections of Sam Dharmasiri filter in Paul Fryer's verified LinkedIn session.

source_and_provenance.source_filter: Connections of Sam Dharmasiri with CTO Type
source_and_provenance.required_checkpoint_style: atomic write after every completed contact or a very small bounded batch
source_and_provenance.resume_rule: Reload the validated checkpoint, skip completed stable lead IDs, and collect only missing IDs because live ordering and page membership may change.

row_height_rules.rule: Every affected populated row must be tall enough to display its longest wrapped cell clearly; taller rows are preferred to clipped or compressed content.

A.name: Company
A.target_row: Required displayed company name from the live profile; use the exact privacy sentinel when LinkedIn hides it.
A.summary_row: Required and identical to the company name on every preceding target row in the block.

B.name: Target Person
B.target_row: Required live Sales Navigator display name.
B.summary_row: Required positive integer-like value equal to the target-row count in the block.

C.name: Target Role
C.target_row: Required source-bound role, company, location, tenure and visible profile context; do not invent missing details.
C.summary_row: Required block summary stating target count, Sam-route coverage and retained additional named-route placements.

E.name: Mutual 1 Notes
E.target_row: Required evidence note for the Sam route, including the filter-evidence caveat when Sam was not in the first visible modal slice.

F.name: Mutual 2
F.target_row: Optional unique additional named mutual visible to Paul Fryer.

G.name: Mutual 2 Notes
G.target_row: Required when F is populated; otherwise blank.

H.name: Mutual 3
H.target_row: Optional unique additional named mutual visible to Paul Fryer.

I.name: Mutual 3 Notes
I.target_row: Required when H is populated; otherwise blank.

J.name: Mutual 4
J.target_row: Optional unique additional named mutual visible to Paul Fryer.

K.name: Mutual 4 Notes
K.target_row: Required when J is populated; otherwise blank.

L.name: Mutual 5
L.target_row: Optional unique additional named mutual visible to Paul Fryer.

M.name: Mutual 5 Notes
M.target_row: Required when L is populated; otherwise blank.

O.name: Found Route Notes
O.target_row: Required current route-depth note for the captured result.

W.name: Final Notes
W.target_row: Optional free text; preserve user-entered text exactly.

X.name: Source / Profile
X.target_row: Required plain-text live-DOM provenance containing the LinkedIn Sales Navigator HTTPS lead URL and ISO-8601 capture timestamp.

Y.name: CRM Status
Y.target_row: Optional status text governed by the two conditional-format rules.

target_person.stable_identity_location: Lead ID embedded in the Sales Navigator URL in X

company_summary.position: Exactly once and last in each company block.

company_block_rules.target_order_within_company: Alphabetical by normalized target display name.
company_block_rules.current_snapshot_company_order: Alphabetical by normalized company display name, with Company not shown on Sales Navigator last.
company_block_rules.future_new_company_entry_rule: Insert each complete new block immediately above the permanent insertion marker. Existing company blocks must never be split. Reordering is allowed only as a separately reviewed whole-block operation.
company_block_rules.privacy_sentinel: Company not shown on Sales Navigator

mutual_route_rules.source_visibility_rule: An additional name may be recorded only when it was visible as a named mutual in Paul Fryer's live Sales Navigator session.
mutual_route_rules.filter_evidence_rule: The Connections of Sam Dharmasiri filter is sufficient primary-route evidence when Sam is not present in the first visible mutuals-panel slice; record that caveat in E.

formula_contract.rule: Do not introduce a formula without an intentional schema-version change and dependency review. Recalculate affected literal snapshot text in the same controlled batch as a data change.

banding.rule: Preserve both the effective themed header and underlying user-entered header fill. Extend the banding end row whenever the data boundary moves.

format_rules.background_source: banding except conditional format in Y

format_rules.rule: Do not restore browser-like underlining to names or source text.

fixed_cells.A1: Northwind CRM Warm Paths Tracker — Sam Dharmasiri
fixed_cells.A2: One row per target person. Companies stay in contiguous blocks; Mutual 1 is always Sam Dharmasiri, followed by up to four additional named mutuals visible to Paul Fryer.
fixed_cells.A3: Current Sam network tracker: 126 companies | 149 target people | 660 named route placements | live Sales Navigator DOM research
fixed_cells.A281: NEW COMPANY INSERTION POINT — Insert every complete new Sam-connected company block immediately above this row. Keep each company contiguous; never overwrite or delete this marker.
fixed_cells.A284: 149 unique CTO-type contacts are grouped into 126 contiguous company blocks. Sam is the primary warm route on every target row, with 511 additional named route placements retained for wider introduction options.
fixed_cells.C286: Every company is represented by one contiguous block; one privacy-limited profile is kept in an explicit company-not-shown block.
fixed_cells.C287: All 149 live Sales Navigator results are retained once, keyed by unique LinkedIn lead ID.
fixed_cells.C288: Sam Dharmasiri is Mutual 1 for every target contact.
fixed_cells.C289: Named mutual-route placements beyond Sam, retained up to the five-column sheet limit.
fixed_cells.C290: Distinct additional mutual contacts visible to Paul Fryer, excluding Sam.
fixed_cells.C291: 141 targets have at least one additional named mutual beyond Sam.
fixed_cells.C292: Average 4.43 named route placements per target, including Sam.
fixed_cells.C294: Zero duplicate lead IDs, duplicate names, blank titles, or blank company labels.
fixed_cells.C295: David King’s employer was not displayed; the sheet records that limitation instead of inferring a company.
fixed_cells.A296: How to use: prioritise the strongest role fit and warmest route, update Current Stage as outreach progresses, and keep route-specific notes beside the corresponding named mutual.

calculation_rules.portfolio_coverage: Count distinct contiguous company blocks, including the privacy sentinel block.
calculation_rules.target_people: Count unique stable LinkedIn lead IDs.
calculation_rules.primary_warm_route: Count target rows whose D value is exactly Sam Dharmasiri.
calculation_rules.additional_route_depth: Count nonblank unique-per-row names in F, H, J and L.
calculation_rules.network_breadth: Count distinct normalized additional mutual names in F, H, J and L, excluding Sam.
calculation_rules.multi_route_coverage: Count target rows having at least one additional named mutual in F, H, J or L.
calculation_rules.relationship_volume: Primary Sam routes plus additional mutual placements; display average total placements per target to two decimal places.
calculation_rules.contact_density: Unique target count divided by company-block count; display to two decimal places.
calculation_rules.data_quality: Reconcile unique lead IDs, duplicate names, required fields and company-block integrity.
calculation_rules.research_caveat: Count privacy-limited target profiles whose employer was not visible.

network_summary.update_rule: When target or company data changes, recalculate the executive statement, every metric value, every commercial-meaning statement, the A3 snapshot and all affected row boundaries in the same controlled batch.

insertion_marker.relative_position: Immediately below the final company-summary row and immediately above the summary spacer.
insertion_marker.new_company_action: Use insertDimension immediately above the marker for the complete target-row set plus exactly one company-summary row. Copy native target and summary row structures separately before overwriting planned values.

integrity_assertions: The tab contains exactly 149 target rows keyed by 149 unique stable LinkedIn lead IDs at the version 1.0.0 snapshot.
Every target row has Sam Dharmasiri exactly once in D and a paired evidence note in E.
Every populated additional mutual-name cell has a paired note; a note must not exist without its paired name.
No normalized mutual name occurs twice on one target row.
A visible mutual count without a visible name is not recorded as a named route.
Every company occurs in exactly one contiguous block.
Every company block contains all target rows first and exactly one company-summary row last.
The company-summary B value equals the number of target rows in its block.
Company-summary columns D:Y are blank and have no dropdown validation.
Target-row N values satisfy the exact eight-option dropdown.
Target-row X contains source-bound live-DOM provenance, a LinkedIn Sales Navigator HTTPS lead URL and an ISO-8601 capture time.
Missing source fields are represented honestly; synthetic companies, inferred employers and fabricated route names are forbidden.
Rows 6:296 are wrapped, content-fitted and top-aligned except the explicitly middle-aligned marker/title/header cells.
Names and source text are not underlined; the source column remains plain text.
The banding, conditional-format ranges, insertion marker, summary positions, A3 snapshot and contract counts move together when the data boundary changes.
Search and Warm Paths are byte-for-byte unchanged by edits scoped to this tab unless an independent reviewed change explicitly targets them.
Column Z remains blank and reserved.
change_protocol: Read docs/northwind_sam_dharmasiri_sheet_contract.md, this machine contract and both parent Warm Paths contract files before every edit.
Create a dated Drive copy of the complete workbook before changing values, rows, formats, formulas, validations, dimensions, banding or conditional formatting.
Read current workbook metadata and exact affected CellData immediately before writing; inspect validation and formats rather than relying on displayed text alone.
For new LinkedIn collection, checkpoint every completed contact atomically by stable lead ID and resume from missing validated IDs, never from a remembered page number.
Plan the complete target-row and company-summary shape before writing. Never use a values-only append.
For an existing company, insert new target rows immediately before that company's summary row. For a new company, insert one complete block immediately above the permanent marker.
Copy a native target row for target structure and a native company-summary row for summary structure; clear stale row-specific values and overwrite only the planned fields.
Apply the Current Stage dropdown to all and only target rows. Summary rows must remain blank and unvalidated in N.
Extend the data range, banding, Y conditional-format ranges and insertion/summary positions atomically when the row boundary changes.
Recalculate A3, the executive statement and every network-summary metric from the updated validated rows in the same batch.
Auto-resize only the affected populated rows from 6:296 after changing wrapped content. Never force data or summary rows to 21 px and never autofit the whole sheet.
Re-read all affected values, formats, validation, merges, row/column dimensions, banding and conditional rules. Compare all non-targeted cells with the pre-edit backup.
Verify stable-ID uniqueness, block contiguity, summary counts, Sam-first route ordering, paired notes, source provenance, dropdown validity and blank reserved regions.
Inspect the Google-rendered tab at normal zoom for clipping, underlining drift, awkward wrapping, damaged borders or a format boundary.
Write a verification report and hashes under Evidence, then update both dedicated and parent contracts if the controlled snapshot or structure changed.
prohibited_actions: Deleting or overwriting the permanent insertion marker.
Writing a new company below the insertion marker or inside the summary region.
Sorting individual rows across company boundaries.
Splitting one company across non-adjacent row ranges.
Using a values-only append or copying a company-summary row as a target row.
Adding a mutual name that was not visible in live evidence.
Treating a displayed mutual count as a named mutual route.
Inferring a hidden employer, title, location, person or route.
Trusting browser memory, result position or a stale page number as the completion ledger.
Applying dropdown validation to company-summary rows.
Restoring hyperlink-style underlining to names or source text.
Forcing populated rows to a uniform 21 px height.
Whole-sheet autofit, restyling or formatting normalization.
Introducing formulas, tables, filters, charts, protected ranges or smart chips without a reviewed schema-version change.
Changing Search or Warm Paths as an incidental consequence of a Sam-tab edit.
